scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gateway/web" "npm run start:dev -w @gateway/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gateway/contracts && npm run build -w @gateway/api && npm run build -w @gateway/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gateway/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @gateway/api && npm run typecheck -w @gateway/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @gateway/api && npm run lint -w @gateway/web
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
